name: Veyrona
summary: Veyrona embodies refined luminosity. A silver mirror surface reflects light with subtle brilliance, balanced by a matte white back panel that softens the composition with quiet restraint. Metal elements in brushed bronze add warmth and distinction, completing a design that is both modern and timeless. Elegant in proportion and poised in detail, Veyrona speaks to interiors where sophistication is defined by harmony and light.
